definitions.name: Get Spreadsheet
definitions.description: Get Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation: Get Spreadsheet: GET /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.description: Create Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation: Create Spreadsheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CREATE_SPREADSHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.description: Batch Get Values By Data Filter
definitions.documentation: Batch Get Values By Data Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchGetByDataFilter. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.name: Append Values
definitions.description: Append Values
definitions.documentation: Append Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values/{range}:append. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=APPEND_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.name: Batch Update Values
definitions.description: Batch Update Values
definitions.documentation: Batch Update Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.documentation: Batch Update Values By Data Filter: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchUpdateByDataFilter. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_VALUES_BY_FILTER. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.name: Batch Clear Values
definitions.description: Batch Clear Values
definitions.documentation: Batch Clear Values: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/values:batchClear. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_CLEAR_VALUES. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. definitions.name: Search Developer Metadata
definitions.description: Search Developer Metadata
definitions.documentation: Search Developer Metadata: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}/developerMetadata:search. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. definitions.name: Batch Update Spreadsheet
definitions.description: Batch Update Spreadsheet
definitions.documentation: Batch Update Spreadsheet: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=BATCH_UPDATE_SPREADSHEET. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Update Cells
definitions.description: Update Cells
definitions.documentation: Update Cells: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UPDATE_CELLS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Sort Range
definitions.description: Sort Range
definitions.documentation: Sort Range: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=SORT_RANGE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes

definitions.name: Add Named Range
definitions.description: Add Named Range
definitions.documentation: Add Named Range: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ADD_NAMED_RANGE. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.documentation: Delete Developer Metadata: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=DELETE_DEVELOPER_METADATA. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. definitions.name: Unmerge Cells
definitions.description: Unmerge Cells
definitions.documentation: Unmerge Cells: POST /v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=UNMERGE_CELLS. Reconcile uncertain outcomes before rerunning. Fixed HTTPS sheets.googleapis.com, redirects rejected; one request, retries zero, no automatic pagination or refresh. Externally issued OAuth access token via encrypted GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN (or tokenSecret), or config.$connection RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken. Profile settings are RuntimeConnection.config; password is not an OAuth token. API key mode accepts credentials.apiKey or GOOGLE_SHEETS_API_KEY for public reads only; it grants no spreadsheet authorization. POST data-filter reads remain read operations. OAuth scopes spreadsheet.readonly for eligible reads and spreadsheets or drive.file for authorized writes; permissions/scopes/API enablement and renewal are external. API-key auth is a header so it is never placed in the URL. Total 10s default/30s maximum deadline begins before profile/secret resolution; request 256KiB, response 1MiB, max100 ranges/requests/sheets, 1000x1000 cells still subject to byte bound, 16KiB URL, 250ms cleanup. Strict UTF-8/UTF-16; exact dot route fragments rejected. Known resource fields are projected; unsupported metadata/format/chart fields are omitted. RAW writes preserve literals, USER_ENTERED can evaluate formulas; null value cells are skipped by Google while an empty string clears a value. Grid indices are zero-based/exclusive-end; omitted range bounds remain unbounded at Google. A1 strings pass unchanged after safe percent encoding. Batch structural requests support the documented typed subset; no arbitrary JSON requests. Find/replace requires one explicit allSheets/sheetId/range scope. Values writes/clears, batch actions and append are not compare-and-swap operations; concurrent edits can race. Append has no idempotency key. No Drive sharing/file deletion, OAuth login/refresh, export/import, continuous listeners or provider verification. Sources: https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets.values https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api/scopes
